CommunityApplications.Profile:
Headless Zed development environment: an SSH server plus a full Linux toolchain (git, build-essential) in a container. Install it, drop your public key into appdata/zed-docker/.ssh/authorized_keys, then connect from your local Zed via SSH Remote Development (zed ssh://dev@[IP]:2222/home/dev/workspace). Zed installs and runs its headless editor server inside the container automatically.
  • Zed GUI stays on your machine — files, terminals, language servers, and tasks run here
  • Key-based SSH only, root login denied
  • AppData keeps your SSH keys and Zed's server install across container updates
  • No WebUI — SSH is the interface (port 2222)
Requirements: Zed v0.159+ on your client machine.
